answer_1.quote: One important downstream task for disentangled representation learning (DRL) is conditional generation. ... we conduct experiments on two text-generation tasks: style transfer and conditional generation.

answer_2.quote: To measure generation quality for both tasks, we test the following metrics ... Style Preservation ... Content Preservation ... Generation Quality ... Geometric Mean ...

answer_4.quote: Due to the limitation of manual effort, we only evaluate the style transfer performance on Yelp datasets. The generated sentences are manually evaluated on style accuracy (SA), content preservation (CP), and sentence fluency (SF).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to justify the style label, rate content preservation and sentence fluency for each generated sentence.
